generation.scope: The unreflected semisimple Bell line has a six-dimensional weighted projective fiber modulo eight or sixteen explicit comparisons. Every lift has period at most two; the nonzero period-one locus has eight components generically and five at the order-four collision. This completes the coverage, indexed-isomorphism and period tests for all windows whose closed orbit has an invertible two-plane split. All are regular and none have branching point fibers.

open_mathematics: Work on the specialization-open complementary stable and branched windows and on criteria for good integral models of moving regular classes. Do not equate the split-attracted subatlas with the full classification.
